categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the wool textile industry, focusing on the production and sale of wool tops, shrink-resistant wool tops, carbonized wool, and short wool tops. It also engages in outsourcing certain high-pollution, high-energy processes such as wool washing. Additionally, the company has invested in solar power generation projects to diversify income sources.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes traditional wool processing techniques including washing, carding, combing, and blending with functional fibers. It has outsourced high-energy and high-pollution washing processes to reduce costs and environmental impact. The company is also expanding solar photovoltaic (PV) power systems to reduce energy costs and carbon emissions, integrating green energy into its operations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are yarn and fabric manufacturers in the textile industry, including producers of woven, knitted, and circular knit fabrics. Major markets include Taiwan, Japan, Turkey, Southeast Asia, and other regions, with a significant portion of exports to China, India, Italy, Czech Republic, and South Korea. The company serves general sales customers without significant concentration in any single client.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with manufacturing facilities in New Taipei City and Keelung. Its sales markets cover domestic Taiwan and export markets including Japan, Turkey, Southeast Asia, China, India, Italy, Czech Republic, and South Korea. The company is actively seeking to expand into new overseas markets beyond Asia to diversify regional risks.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the wool textile supply chain, processing raw wool into wool tops and related products for downstream yarn and fabric manufacturers. It sources raw wool mainly from Australian auctions and some from New Zealand, and outsources certain processing steps to third parties.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding solar power generation capacity to reduce energy costs and carbon footprint, improving production efficiency through equipment upgrades, and developing high-quality, specialized wool products with environmental functions. The company emphasizes ESG and sustainability, including carbon emission monitoring and waste recycling. R&D focuses on solar PV system enhancements and energy-saving technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of wool tops and related wool textile products. Additional income streams include outsourcing processing services, rental income from factory space, and revenue from solar power generation sold to the electric utility. The company does not rely on subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company faces strong competition from Chinese wool processing firms, which have engaged in low-price competition due to overcapacity and economic downturns. Despite this, the company maintains a competitive position by focusing on quality, specialized products, and flexible production. Rising costs and environmental regulations in China may benefit the company's long-term competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported net operating revenue of approximately NT$1.04 billion in the latest fiscal year, a 16% decrease from the prior year, with an operating loss of about NT$58.9 million. Despite operating losses, overall net profit after tax was positive due to non-operating income such as investments and solar power revenue. The company has a stable asset base of around NT$3.46 billion and equity of NT$3.23 billion, with a modest return on assets and equity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, specialized wool products with environmental and functional benefits, differentiating itself through product quality and sustainability. It leverages outsourced processing to reduce costs and environmental impact, and integrates green energy solutions to enhance corporate social responsibility and operational efficiency. Its long-standing reputation and adherence to ESG principles further strengthen its market position.
